annotations.text:
Direction: same brand DNA, dressed for a compliance buyer.

Kept exactly: the Space Mono wordmark, the emerald accent (#34D399 / #059669), the near-black base, 8px radii and 44px+ controls.

Changed: Instrument Sans added for body copy so Space Mono goes back to being a label face; the 2px brutalist gutters replaced with real 20px gaps and hairline-edged cards; emerald used at roughly a fifth of its old frequency; section rhythm opened to 120px; the abstract network graphic replaced with a sample result card, so the hero shows the actual deliverable.

Alternate direction.

Same layout and copy, light institutional palette — the register procurement and risk teams tend to expect.

Tradeoff: safer and more legible in a boardroom, but it gives up the technical distinctiveness the dark build has. Logo is unchanged, just rendered on light.
